title: Auramine–rhodamine as a fluorochrome AFB method
dek: A Wikipedia stain cousin of ZN used for screening. Still not a species, still not a WRD.
story: Auramine–rhodamine on Wikipedia is a fluorochrome acid-fast method: screening smears under fluorescence is faster than oil-immersion ZN for many labs.
Programmes often confirm fluorescence hits with ZN. That workflow is local policy, not a law of physics.
The property is still acid-fastness. All smear caveats (viability, NTM, not DST) transfer.
deep: LED microscopy is a WHO-relevant implementation detail on smear plates.
Over-decolorizing and quenching are method errors, not new taxa.
Do not skip Ultra because fluorescence is efficient.

visual.caption: Teaching bars: screening throughput versus taxonomic information. Not a lab tender.
